This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2025.
The following states are eligible for the title of Southern Champion: 

- Arkansas
- Louisiana
- Mississippi
- Oklahoma
- Texas 

All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2025#55871-important-information-faq) prior to registering.

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
